similarities.point: Both texts identify the subject as an engineer.
similarities.quote_britannica: Billinger who had long been known as an able Engineer
similarities.quote_wikipedia: He served as a sapper with the 44 Royal Engineer Commandos

differences.point: The texts describe different people, nationalities, and centuries.
differences.quote_britannica: He died at Settargar the 18th of February 1750
differences.quote_wikipedia: Harry Billinge MBE (15 September 1925 – 5 April 2022) was a British soldier

differences.point: The Britannica subject held high political office, while the Wikipedia subject was a soldier and fundraiser.
differences.quote_wikipedia: raising more than £25,000 towards the cost of construction of the British Normandy Memorial

claims.claim: Billinger was an able Engineer who made improvements to the system of fortification.
claims.quote_britannica: Billinger who had long been known as an able Engineer, and had, indeed, made some improvements of value in the received system of Portification
He died at Settargar the 18th of February 1750

claims.claim: Billinger's works included Elementa Physics, published in Leipzig in 1742.
Billinger was a member of the Royal Academy of Berlin.
claims.quote_britannica: member of the Royal Academy of Berlin
